page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: dam , tuendam religionem reformatam, & ad conservanda defendendaque jura, privilegia, libertatem provinciarum fœderatarum generatim, & provinciæ hujus inter Lavicam & Amasum speciatim: postremò munus sibi commissum cum fide & diligentiâ administraturos, concordiæ & amicitiæ colendæ sincerum studium habituros, Reip. provinciali salutem pro viribus procuraturos. Ab hoc tempore bonorum monasticorum administratio desiit esse penes hoc collegium, translataque est ad collegium aliud huic curæ peculiariter destinatum, de quo dicam postea. Et jam Dammonenses in causâ suâ agendâ erant toti, contendebantque, se eo jure, quod cæteris Ordinibus agrariis per sententiam irrogatum esset, haud teneri, quippè qui aliquid præ iis haberent præcipuî, repetita memoria actorum tempore Mariæ gubernatricis Belgii cœptorum. Tandem verò disceptato, quantum satis erat, negotio, à judicibus delegatis ex voluntate collegii generalium Ordinum Hagæ duæ sententiæ sunt latæ alia post aliam, prior anno superiore, altera hoc ipso

page.notes: Pale stains and a grey smudge at lower left, and a faint digitiser mark at lower right, are not printed text and were left out. The first word of the page is a fragment ("dam") and is kept as such. The catchword "ipso" is set at the foot right, and the text is not repeated there. Doubtful: "præcipuî" final letter may be a printing variant, and "tempore" may contain a Cyrillic-like letter in the scan; transcribed as printed.
